newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - May 28.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The government has received proposals for setting up six more Export Processing Zone (EPZ) in the private sector.
A frigate of the French Navy with 200 officers and sailors on board arrived in Chittagong on Tuesday on a five-day goodwill visit.
The World Bank has said Bangladesh immediately needs to ensure an effective legal system, good management and strong central bank to aviod any crisis in its banking system.
At least 100 people were injured as a nor'wester lashed different parts of southern Barisal and Pirojur districts on Tuesday.
Bangladesh is likely to act in line with the decision of the Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) in recognising the Taliban government in Afghanistan.
Nearly 50 percent of Bangladeshi couples are now using contraceptives, says a USAID study.
Nearly 50,000 tonnes of imported sugar will arrive at Bangladesh ports by the middle of June.
Bangladesh produced 53.52 million kilograms of tea in 1996, up by more than 12 percent from the previous year. REUTER
